Furniture upholstery in Woodland Hills

If you like the way your sofa sits or the way a favorite chair fits the room, new fabric may be worth a look. We help you explore reupholstery, starting with the piece you already own.

Discuss your furniture(818) 884-5464
Photo placeholder

A piece worth keeping

A good frame, a family connection or a size that fits just right can make furniture hard to replace. Reupholstery gives you a way to consider a different fabric while keeping the piece you like.

John is straightforward about the cost: reupholstering can cost as much as new furniture, or more. It makes sense to compare both options, especially if you’re not attached to the piece.

A frame you value

Tell us what you like about the piece, whether it’s the construction, comfort or a connection to your family.

A size that works

A custom-sized sofa or sectional may fit a particular corner or room in a way a new piece doesn’t.

A different look

We can compare fabrics and ask our upholstery specialist about changes you have in mind for the shape of the piece.

What goes into your upholstery quote

We start by talking about the furniture and your budget. From there, we can bring fabric samples, take photos and measurements, and review the work with an upholstery specialist.

Once we have the specialist’s assessment, we prepare your quote so you can decide whether to go ahead. The conversation is about what’s right for your furniture, rather than assuming every piece needs to be saved.

  • Photos showing the whole piece and any worn areas
  • What you like about it and what you’d change
  • Your ideas for fabric, color or pattern
  • The location of the furniture and your general budget

Questions about furniture reupholstery

Ask John: (818) 884-5464
Is reupholstery less expensive than buying new furniture?

Not necessarily. It can cost as much as a new piece or more. The reasons to consider it often include the frame, comfort, custom size or sentimental value. We’ll help you compare the cost with what the piece means to you.

Can I choose a different fabric?

Yes. We can bring samples and talk about the color, pattern and feel you’re looking for. Tell us how the furniture is used so we can help narrow the choices.

Can the shape of a sofa or chair be changed?

Some changes may be possible. John has worked with an upholstery specialist on adjustments such as reshaping an arm or changing the look of a back. Share photos and your ideas so we can find out what’s appropriate for your piece.

Tell us about the piece you have in mind.

Email a few photos or call John to talk about your furniture. Our Woodland Hills showroom serves Los Angeles and nearby Valley communities; showroom visits are by appointment.
